merchantId.description: The ID of the merchant this Company belongs to, that is your own merchant.

tenant.description: Has the value "live" if the object exists in live mode, or "sand" if it exists in test mode.
tenant.title: TenantMode

joinCode.description: A unique 6-character code that can be used to join or reference this Company.

referenceId.description: The ID of the Company in your own system. Unique among your Companies, so a Payment can find the Company by it.

priceAdjustmentPercentage.description: The percentage applied to catalogue prices for this Company. Positive values raise them, negative values lower them.

allOf.description: The prepaid policy that the Customer is subject to.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the prepaid policy is currently active.

amount.description: The maximum amount, in cents, that the Customer is allowed to spend in a single Date under this policy.

allOf.title: Customers.PrepaidPolicy

prepaidPolicy.description: The prepaid policy applied to the Customers of this Company.

packagingType.description: The packaging used by the Customers of this Company that do not set one of their own. Null when the Company follows the ecommerce site default.

addresses.description: An array of delivery addresses associated with this Company. Each address can have specific delivery fees and store information.

items.description: An address associated with a Company, typically used for delivery purposes.

label.description: A friendly label or name for this address (e.g., "Main Office", "Warehouse").

streetName.description: The street name of the address.

streetNumber.description: The street number of the address.

province.description: The province or state of the address.

postalCode.description: The postal or ZIP code of the address.

country.description: The country code of the address (e.g., "IT" for Italy).

deliveryFeeAmount.description: The delivery fee amount for this address, in cents.

storeId.description: The unique identifier of the store associated with this address.

items.title: CompanyAddressForExternalApi

allOf.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. It can contain up to 10 key-value items with a maximum length of 40 for the key and of 400 chars for the value.
allOf.title: Metadata

metadata.description: The fields of the Company, as you set them. A key the merchant declared in the Dashboard has the type declared there, any other key is text, and segments can filter Customers by the fields of their Company.
